name: gl-react
role: React components that compose GLSL shaders as a node graph over textures
summary: React library where each shader is a Node component taking uniforms and other nodes or images as inputs, rendered to WebGL surfaces. Suited to image effect chains such as blur, colour grading and transitions described declaratively. Distinguishing strength: shader composition as a React tree. Little 3D support and a long gap before the 2026 release.
use_when: 2D image or frame effect chains already living in a React tree
Over Three.js post effects when there is no 3D scene, only textures and fragment shaders
avoid_when: Plain fragment shaders without React: glslcanvas or regl
3D scenes with effects: Three.js with postprocessing
Steadier release cadence wanted: OGL or regl
notes: 2026-10-26: React 19 compatibility of 6.0.0 and the gl-react-dom surface package were not verified.

assessment.rationale: npm 6.0.0 published May 2026 after four years without a release (5.2.x in 2022); repo pushed Oct 2026; MIT. Overlaps Three.js post effects and raw GLSL tools and ties shaders to the React render cycle.
